# BLAKE3 (C)

The portable C implementation and x86-64 assembly of BLAKE3 1.8.3, unmodified, from
<https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3> (`c/`). Licensed CC0-1.0, Apache-2.0, or Apache-2.0 with
the LLVM exception, at your option: `LICENSE_CC0`, `LICENSE_A2`, `LICENSE_A2LLVM`.

The AVA1 C library uses it for manifest and verification-group hashes (`ava1_b3.c`).
